page_title: KOL 0-1 WER | FC Koln v Werder Bremen 16/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Daniel Siebert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' FC Koln take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+9' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+8' A pass into the penalty area from Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by the defence.
90+5' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Siebert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+5' FC Koln couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+4' Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Senne Lynen.
90+2' Today's referee Daniel Siebert rightly decides to book Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) for his harsh tackle.
90+1' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
88' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is booked for saying more than Daniel Siebert was willing to tolerate.
88' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. FC Koln are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dejan Ljubicic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) is coming onto the pitch as Benno Schmitz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' The game has come to an end for Mitchell Weiser. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
83' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) replacing Marvin Ducksch.
83' A substitution has been made. Romano Schmid is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
81' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) brings an opponent down and Daniel Siebert interrupts the game.
79' A lofted cross from Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
78' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a cross on the edge of the box and quickly shoots. He sends the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper quickly reacts and makes a good save.
77' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is penalised.
77' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) gets a yellow card. The referee Daniel Siebert made the right call.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln), comes to nothing.
75' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
75' Corner kick. Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) is ready to send the ball into the box.
74' Here is a change. Linton Maina is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln) for Eric Martel.
74' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
70' 0 - 1 Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!

69' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
69' The referee blows his whistle as Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in his challenge. FC Koln win a free kick.
67' Timo Schultz has decided to substitute Florian Kainz and he is replaced by Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln).
66' Substitution. Nick Woltemade makes his way off the pitch and Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) comes on as his replacement.
64' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
63' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
62' The ball rebounds to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
61' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner.
61' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Werder Bremen earn a corner.
60' Wow, what an escape. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
59' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
54' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe is equal to it and makes an easy save.
54' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) brought his opponent down.
52' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
51' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
49' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
48' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
48' An accurate cross finds its way to Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
47' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michael Zetterer intercepts the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
43' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
42' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
41' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will take a corner kick.
40' FC Koln string together a series of short passes.
36' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul after Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) hacks down one of his opponents.
36' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) but poses no threat.
35' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer was alert and made a comfortable save.

33' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
32' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marvin Schwabe, who smothers the ball.
31' A lofted pass finds Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
28' FC Koln are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
26' The referee Daniel Siebert awards Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) a yellow card.
26' A yellow-coloured card is received by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen).
26' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Werder Bremen.
23' A clumsy foul by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
20' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Werder Bremen get a corner.
18' The foul by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
16' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
14' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
12' A pass by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
5' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
2' A pass from Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by Michael Zetterer and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Daniel Siebert will officiate today.
